label: measured on simulated days with no events; not a guarantee about real data
rule: the full candidate rule: BH filter at 0.05, observed >= 10, observed/usual >= 2
dispersion: negative binomial, variance = mean + mean^2/k, k shared within a complaint type, scaled by a factor between 0.7 and 1.3 per type; 1.5x/2x/3x is the variance as a multiple of the Poisson variance for the median simulated series (mean 9) on average across types (at 2x it ranges from 1.77 to 2.43 across types); busier series are more spread than that
